candidates.after:
flowchart LR
  C[Profiling module] --> D[Deep communication detector interface]
  D --> R[Rule catalog implementation]
  D --> L[Rule provenance]
candidates.before:
flowchart LR
  C[Profiling module] --> D[Communication detector interface]
  C --> R[Concrete rule catalog]
  R --> D
  C --> L[Rule-version log]
evidence: The detector implementation owns the catalog and performs all rule matching.
The profiling module separately receives or loads the same concrete catalog only to log its Version after detector completion.
Deleting the coordinator's direct catalog dependency would concentrate catalog provenance rather than move rule-matching complexity into callers.
The accepted plan records this exact locality work as deferred, so it is non-reserved and does not reopen Story 4.3 scope.
candidates.problem: The Communication Kind Classification implementation owns and interprets the embedded communication rule catalog, but RepositoryProfilingCoordinator also depends on the concrete catalog solely to load and log its version. Rule-set provenance therefore leaks across the detector seam and enlarges both coordinator construction interfaces.
candidates.solution: Explore concentrating rule-set provenance and its observability inside the communication-detection module so callers consume one deep detector interface and do not separately understand its catalog implementation.
candidates.title: Concentrate communication rule-set provenance behind the detector seam

candidates.after:
flowchart LR
  I[Scan Run repository interface] --> C[Composite profile commit]
  C --> E[Atomic structural and Pre-Scan persistence]
  T[Test adapters] --> I
candidates.before:
flowchart LR
  I[Scan Run repository interface] --> A[Unused structural staging]
  A --> E[Three EF AddRange calls]
  I --> C[Composite profile commit]
  T[Test adapters] --> A
evidence: Repository-wide production call-site inspection found no AddStructuralRecords caller.
The implementation is a direct three-collection EF staging pass-through.
Test repository adapters retain forwarding code solely because the interface exposes the operation.
Under the deletion test, removing this member deletes complexity without redistributing it to production callers.
candidates.problem: IScanRunRepository retains AddStructuralRecords even though no integrated production caller uses it. Its implementation only forwards three collections to EF AddRange, while fake adapters must repeat the same pass-through interface member.
candidates.solution: Delete the unused staging operation and keep completed structural writes concentrated behind the existing composite Repository Profile plus Pre-Scan Result persistence implementation.
candidates.title: Delete the unused structural-record staging operation
